paragraphs: Univerus Sport & Recreation is the sport and recreation division of Univerus Software Inc. It sells two cloud products to public-sector and institutional buyers. Univerus Rec is recreation management software for municipal parks and recreation departments, community centres, campus recreation at universities and colleges, camps and nonprofits. It covers facility booking across multiple locations, online program registration (custom pricing, discounts, waitlists, attendance, digital waivers), membership management (family accounts, recurring payments, a self-service member portal), point-of-sale with multiple registers and inventory, and staff scheduling with shift trading and certification tracking. Univerus Sport is aimed at university and college athletic departments, school district sports programs and leagues. It handles athlete registration, athlete and coach records, eligibility and compliance tracking, email and SMS messaging, team travel, wellness checks and historical awards. Both products run on a shared "UNITY" platform with single sign-on.

The pitch is that one system replaces paper forms, spreadsheets and older recreation systems. In Univerus Rec, a resident books a gym or field, signs up for a class or buys a family membership through the online portal or on mobile. Payment goes through Univerus's own payment processing. Staff then run the front desk from the same system, with scheduling, reporting and financials all in one place. It also connects to TeamLinkt, a league-management tool, and has an API. On the athletics side, Univerus Sport takes eligibility and compliance paperwork out of spreadsheets and email and tracks it against a central athlete record. The division says it has more than 500 sport and recreation clients, including about 325 municipalities and 100+ universities and organizations, and manages over 83,000 athletes. Its customers are mostly in Canada, with a growing U.S. base; recent wins include the Township of Champlain and Carleton's Dominion-Chalmers Centre.
